mechanistic_scope: Retain three enables edges with explicit sequence-based individual assignments and whole-operon experimental support.
Retain observed ectoine output after induced operon expression.
No isolated-enzyme catalyzes claims, elementary reactions, cofactor edges, cellular compartment or osmotic-regulator nodes.
Do not copy Halomonas EctB cofactor or oligomerization assertions to Sporosarcina; the primary paper distinguishes those species.

Retain native locus accession without invented boundaries: source JSON uses zero coordinates, which importer treats as unknown. CDS coordinates above document individual proteins, not a complete regulatory interval.

chemical_grounding.label: ectoine
chemical_grounding.basis: Source MIBiG structure CC1=NCC[C@H](N1)C(=O)O with C6H10N2O2; ChEBI neutral stereochemical entry. CHEBI:58515 is ectoine zwitterion and must not be substituted merely because already in corpus.

deferred.label: violacein
reasons: Native AF172851.1 annotation contains vioA-D; PMID:16874749 and PMID:17176066 require VioE for the full pathway. Exact same-scope VioE accession not established in this scan.
PMID:17925955 corrects intermediate identity and distinguishes nonenzymatic final chemistry; avoid simply replaying earlier pathway prose.
deferred.followup: Resolve missing VioE on the deposited locus and scope before a complete biosynthetic canary.

deferred.label: radicicol
reasons: Source locus evidence is explicitly homology-based prediction and genomic/metabolomic correlation; individual same-strain gene causality has not been established in this bounded review.
deferred.followup: Inspect DOI:10.1016/j.mycres.2009.10.001 and DOI:10.1186/s12864-016-2546-0 for exact strain/gene validation; do not equate high quality flag with experimentally tested gene roles.

deferred.label: kotanin
reasons: Native source contains five genes; KtnD catalytic role is explicitly unresolved in later primary study DOI:10.3389/fmicb.2020.00931.
Native CBS513.88 locus and original knockout-study strain FGSC A1180 need explicit identity/scope reconciliation. Original 2012 paper full text was unavailable in this scan.
deferred.followup: Inspect DOI:10.1002/anie.201203603 and reconcile strain/native IDs. Unknown KtnD role can remain metadata; not a reason to invent a catalytic edge.

adversarial_review.biological_review: Independent review confirmed strain, source proteins, neutral product and qualified whole-operon scope.
adversarial_review.resolution: Replace narrative literature source_assertion items with inspected GenBank XML annotations and MIBiG locus/product statements, plus one short verbatim primary-paper production quote. This does not strengthen the gene-specific evidence beyond similarity annotations.
adversarial_review.production_quote_locator: Abstract, sentence following the three Ect protein names. Exact substring independently inspected at https://journals.asm.org/doi/10.1128/aem.68.2.772-783.2002 and present in cached PMID11823218.xml.
